title: The optimal bit complexity of integer multiplication
formal: What is the optimal worst-case asymptotic time for multiplying two n-bit integers on a deterministic multitape Turing machine?
context:
An O(n log n) upper bound is known. Lower bounds in restricted branching-program or bounded-coefficient models do not settle this model.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: One of the most basic unresolved limits of exact computation, affecting fast arithmetic throughout algorithms.
